meta_description: The OpenDrone flight controller and ESC are paid stock and ship late October 2026. Receivers, frames and motors each have a public funding target. See every price, target and ship date.
title: Order early, pay less, see when it ships.
lead: The flight controller and ESC are in their first production batch, paid for and shipping late October 2026. The receivers, frames and motors are funded here: each product option has a public target, the quantity we order from the supplier. Your preorder pays for that run, and you can watch each target fill.

s1_body: OpenDrone is an open source FPV platform. The flight controller, ESC and receiver are open hardware with public design files. The frame design files are not public yet. The motors come from a motor manufacturer; we select and test them, and they are not open hardware.
Preorders pay for the supplier orders. Where each design stands, from first prototype to production, is on [the roadmap](/roadmap).
s6_body: Hardware schedules slip. Supplier lead times move, a component goes out of stock and has to be replaced by an equivalent, and a production run can need rework. When a ship date moves, you get mail with the new date.

A product can also fall short of its target. If a target is not reached by 31 December 2026, we mail everyone who ordered that product and each buyer chooses: a refund of everything paid for that product within 14 days, or keep the order for the new ship date in that mail. If a buyer does not reply within 30 days, we refund that item. The rest of an order does not wait for a missed target.

Incutec BV is a young company. If it stopped trading before your order shipped, you would have a claim for what you paid as a creditor in the bankruptcy, and you might not get all of it back. If you paid by card, you can also ask your card issuer for a chargeback for goods not delivered, within the card scheme's time limits.
s7_body: Incutec BV, a small company in Leuven, Belgium. The same people design the boards, answer the support mail and pack the parcels.
This is not a crowdfunding platform: you order in our own shop, under [our terms](/en/algemene-voorwaarden), article 7bis.
faq_a1: In full when you order: the product price and shipping. We charge nothing after checkout. Outside the EU, including the United States, the carrier may collect import duties and taxes from you on delivery: see [Shipping](/en/shipping).
faq_a2: The stack ships late October 2026 while batch 1 lasts. Every other product ships about 10 weeks after its target is reached. Every target has a deadline of 31 December 2026: if the target is reached by then, the product is planned to ship by 11 March 2027. If it has not shipped by then, you can cancel that item for a full refund. Each item shows its ship date on the product page, at checkout and on the order confirmation.
faq_q3: What happens when a target is reached?
faq_a3: We place the supplier order and mail everyone who ordered that product. You hear from us again when the ship date is set and before dispatch.
faq_q9: What if a target is not reached?
faq_a9: Every target has a deadline: 31 December 2026. If a product misses it, we mail everyone who ordered it and you choose: a refund of everything you paid for that product within 14 days, or keep your order for the new ship date in that mail. If you do not reply within 30 days, we refund that item. If you keep waiting, you can still cancel for a full refund at any time until delivery. If the refund leaves nothing in your order to ship, we refund the shipping cost too. The rest of your order ships as soon as it is ready, whichever you choose.
faq_q4: What if the ship date moves?
faq_a4: You get mail with the new date as soon as we know it. Until your order is delivered you can still cancel it for a refund.
faq_q5: Do I get one parcel or several?
faq_a5: One, once every item in it is ready. If you split your items over several orders, each order ships and pays shipping on its own. The exception is a missed funding target: the rest of the order then ships as soon as it is ready, and the missed item, if you keep waiting for it, follows in a second parcel at no extra shipping cost.
faq_q6: Do you ship to the United States?
faq_a6: Yes, for €19.95 per order. We do not collect US import duties at checkout: the carrier collects them from you before delivery. US import duty on electronics and motors made in China is high, often around 35 to 40% of the value. US customs sets the amount, not us, and the carrier can add a clearance fee.
faq_a7: No. A preorder pays for the production run of your own order. It carries no interest and gives you no equity, revenue share or other stake in the company. If Incutec BV stopped trading before your order shipped, you would have a claim for what you paid as a creditor in the bankruptcy, and you might not get all of it back. If you paid by card, you can also ask your card issuer for a chargeback for goods not delivered, within the card scheme's time limits.
faq_q8: Where do the numbers on this page come from?
faq_a8: From paid orders in our shop. Each product option counts only its own units, and the numbers refresh every minute.

step1_body: You pay the product price and shipping when you order. We never charge you again after checkout. Shipping is one flat rate per order, for example €8.50 to Belgium and €19.95 to the United States: every rate is on the [Shipping](/en/shipping) page. Outside the EU, the carrier collects any import duties and taxes from you on delivery.
step2_title: The price steps up per product option
step2_body: {ladder} Each product option counts only its own paid orders. The price at checkout is the price you pay.
step3_body: Batch 1 of the flight controller and ESC is paid stock and {stack_ships}. Receivers, frames and motors have a funding target, the smallest run the supplier makes: once a product option reaches it we place the supplier order, and it ships about 10 weeks later. One order ships in one parcel when its last item is ready, so order the stack on its own if you want it in October. Each order pays its own shipping.
step4_body: Every funding target has a deadline: {ends_on}. A target reached by then is planned to ship by 11 March 2027. If a product option misses it, we mail everyone who ordered it and you choose: a refund for that item, or keep waiting. No reply within 30 days means a refund. The rest of your order still ships, and shipping is refunded only if nothing else in the order ships. Until your order is delivered you can also cancel it.
faq_a_price: {ladder} Each product option counts only its own paid orders. The product list above shows the current price of each option and what the next step costs; each product page also shows how many units are left at the current price.
faq_q_cancel: Can I cancel before it ships?
faq_a_cancel: Yes. Until your order is delivered you can withdraw from it without giving a reason: use the [withdrawal form](/en/herroepingsrecht#withdraw) or email contact@opendrone.be. We refund what you paid for it, including the standard shipping cost, within 14 days, to the payment method you used.
faq_q_duties: Do I pay import duties outside the EU?
faq_a_duties: Inside the EU there is nothing more to pay: prices include Belgian VAT. Outside the EU we do not collect import duties or taxes at checkout. Your country's customs may charge them, and the carrier collects them from you on delivery. For the United Kingdom, the price you pay at checkout does not include UK VAT, and the carrier can hold the parcel until UK VAT and a handling fee are paid. For the United States the amount is high: US import duty on electronics and motors made in China is often around 35 to 40% of the value, and US customs sets the amount. Check your country's rules before you order, and see [Shipping](/en/shipping).

nl_body: De winkel is in het Engels. Hier staan de regels voor een voorbestelling kort in het Nederlands. Onze [algemene voorwaarden](/nl/algemene-voorwaarden) bestaan ook in het Nederlands, en die gelden.

Je betaalt bij je bestelling meteen alles: de producten en de verzending. Daarna rekenen we niets meer aan. De prijs stijgt per productoptie naarmate er betaalde bestellingen binnenkomen: eenheden 1 tot 100 kosten 20% minder dan de winkelprijs, eenheden 101 tot 250 kosten 10% minder, en vanaf eenheid 251 geldt de winkelprijs. De prijs bij het afrekenen is de prijs die je betaalt.

De eerste 250 flight controllers en ESC's per maat zijn betaald en in productie. Ze worden eind oktober 2026 verzonden. Ontvangers, frames en motoren hebben een financieringsdoel: zodra dat bereikt is, bestellen we bij de leverancier en verzenden we ongeveer 10 weken later. De deadline voor elk doel is 31 december 2026. Is het doel tegen dan bereikt, dan is de verzending gepland tegen 11 maart 2027.

Wordt een doel niet gehaald, dan mailen we iedereen die dat product bestelde en kies je zelf: je krijgt dat product binnen 14 dagen terugbetaald, of je blijft wachten. Antwoord je niet binnen 30 dagen, dan betalen we terug. De rest van je bestelling wordt gewoon verzonden. Tot de levering kun je je bestelling ook annuleren.

Eén bestelling gaat in één pakket, zodra alles erin klaar is. Wil je de flight controller en ESC in oktober, bestel ze dan apart. Elke bestelling betaalt haar eigen verzending. Verzending met bpost kost € 8,50 binnen België en € 9,95 naar Nederland; alle tarieven staan op de [verzendpagina](/nl/shipping). Vragen? Mail naar contact@opendrone.be.
fr_body: La boutique est en anglais. Voici les règles d'une précommande, en bref et en français. Nos [conditions générales](/fr/algemene-voorwaarden) existent aussi en français, et ce sont elles qui s'appliquent.

Vous payez tout à la commande : les produits et la livraison. Nous ne vous facturons plus rien ensuite. Le prix augmente par option de produit à mesure que les commandes payées arrivent : les unités 1 à 100 coûtent 20 % de moins que le prix de vente, les unités 101 à 250 coûtent 10 % de moins, et à partir de l'unité 251 le prix de vente s'applique. Le prix affiché au paiement est le prix que vous payez.

Les 250 premiers contrôleurs de vol et ESC de chaque taille sont payés et en production. Ils sont expédiés fin octobre 2026. Les récepteurs, châssis et moteurs ont un objectif de financement : une fois atteint, nous passons commande au fournisseur et le produit est expédié environ 10 semaines plus tard. La date limite de chaque objectif est le 31 décembre 2026. Si l'objectif est atteint à cette date, l'expédition est prévue au plus tard le 11 mars 2027.

Si un objectif n'est pas atteint, nous écrivons à tous ceux qui ont commandé ce produit et vous choisissez : le remboursement de ce produit sous 14 jours, ou continuer d'attendre. Sans réponse sous 30 jours, nous remboursons. Le reste de votre commande est expédié normalement. Jusqu'à la livraison, vous pouvez aussi annuler votre commande.

Une commande part en un seul colis, dès que tout ce qu'elle contient est prêt. Si vous voulez le contrôleur de vol et l'ESC en octobre, commandez-les séparément. Chaque commande paie sa propre livraison. La livraison par bpost coûte 8,50 € en Belgique et 9,95 € vers la France ; tous les tarifs sont sur la [page de livraison](/fr/shipping). Des questions ? Écrivez à contact@opendrone.be.
